construction: Project centered normalized QKV and MLP inputs to their empirical rank-128 task spans; reverse the attention output branch; sequentially fit only the MLP output projection to original block outputs on unlabeled calibration images.
fitting: 256 unlabeled MNIST training images, all tokens; twelve closed-form ridge output fits; no gradients or optimizer. Task span estimated on current calibration inputs. Original expert is a defender-side teacher only.
selection: One predeclared rank and gain, no grid; motivated by inspected component dependencies. New confirmation subset excludes all parent subsets and the earlier 4000-image confirmation, but was used during original expert training.
early_stop: Reject if standalone loss exceeds 0.5 pp or the best measured attacker on the release is within 5 pp of the best measured attacker on the unprotected control. Report every matched attack gap, including zero for full support reset. Do not retune this construction. Only survivors proceed to author AGA and functional reconstruction.
threat_model: Attacks receive the released expert, public anchor and partner; no original MNIST weights, defender activations or fitted projector. Canonicalization estimates attention branch sign from public anchor correlations before resetting all MLPs.
novelty: Projection, branch scaling and ridge compensation are known operations. This is a cross-operator representability and replacement-resistance hypothesis, not a novel algorithm claim or security proof. Noninjective individual projections do not establish irreversibility of the complete release.
evaluation: New disjoint 4000-image MNIST training confirmation and previously inspected SVHN-1000 development subset. Not official test, not eight-task Table 6.
